worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.summary: Push a wall of wind forward along a chosen direction, blowing every enemy it sweeps along the wind and driving them out of the fight; an opponent with a reserve is truly switched out. No damage, and standing outside the lane is safe.
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.use.0: Blow a line of enemies away at once
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.use.1: Shove attackers back out of reach
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.use.2: Drive opponents off at long range in the open
Push a wall of wind up to %1$s blocks long and about %2$s blocks wide along your aim; the band you see sweeping the ground is exactly what the move covers.
The wall advances at %1$s blocks per tick; enemies it sweeps are blown about %2$s blocks along the wind.
Anyone blown away is marked Routed for %1$s seconds; while it lasts, anything closer than %2$s blocks is pushed another %3$s blocks along the wind every 10 ticks.
No damage: it only drives opponents out of the engagement. The wall is a straight lane, so stepping out of it dodges the whole move.
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.wide.on: Wide wall on: the gust is x1.35 wider, at the cost of x0.85 lane length and x0.9 blow distance.
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.wide.off: Wide wall off: a narrower, longer lane with a stronger blow, good for clearing at range.
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.growth.0: At level %1$s the lane lengthens to %2$s blocks and the blow reaches %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.growth.1: At level %1$s the lane lengthens to %2$s blocks, the blow reaches %3$s blocks and the grit rises to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.preference.w: On: the gust is x1.35 wider but x0.85 long and x0.9 blow. Off: narrower, longer, blows farther.
worldcombat.skill.whirlwind.preference.a: The companion only considers a whirlwind when an enemy is within this distance; smaller is point-blank, larger opens at range.
Only consider a whirlwind when at least this many enemies are within range; raise it to stay restrained.
When aiming, the companion counts enemies lined up in a corridor this wide behind each candidate and picks the busiest line.
On: it will leave its station under a hold order to cast. Off: it only does so when the enemy is already in reach.
world_combat.move.whirlwind.text.blow: The wind wall carried %1$s opponent(s) away
